FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 31
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 31 as introduced would increase the administrative obligation of the Department of
Human Resources by requiring the department to request a waiver from the United States
Department of Agriculture Food and Nutrition Service to authorize the department to exclude
soda, energy drinks, candy, and prepared desserts from the definition of "eligible foods" for the
Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program. Granting of this waiver would not directly affect
state or local funding, as it only changes the eligible foods that can be purchased and not the
amount of benefits received by SNAP beneficiaries.
